book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: بعد كم أسبوع، وقفنا عند جزيرة زغيرة.
sentences.en: After a few weeks, we stopped at a small island.
We got out on it and played and cooked food.
We lit a fire on the ground to heat the food.
Suddenly, the ground moved under our feet.
The captain shouted from the ship: run!

sentences.ar: هاي مش جزيرة، هاي حوت نايم.
sentences.en: This is not an island, this is a sleeping whale.
The whale felt the fire and dived into the sea.
The men ran to the ship and I was late.
I was left alone in the water.
